title: A Summit for the Compass
author: Jude Galloway
blurb: Jude Marchetti, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
